thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated latency and request queueing observed for model family 'redwood-alpha' (svc: inference-prod-apac). Alerts: 3xx latency spikes, queue length > 200 for 5m. https://incidents.internal/INC-2024-0921

clara-h: seeing the same in the dashboard. P50 -> 1.6s, P95 -> 8.9s, token generation stalls. Confirming customers reporting timed-out requests.

ben_custops: AcmeCorp and ZephyrApps reported errors to support, both on Dedicated but routing through shared model variants. AcmeCorp has heavy conversational throughput right now.

priya-s: runtime traces show that redwood-alpha kv-cache misses spiked after a variant rollout ~10:30UTC. Kernel selection fallback causing extra memcopies.

mateo-r: tagging this Sev2 for now. Can we do a quick traffic mitigation per-model to relieve pressure? Prefer not to take the whole pool down.

clara-h: agreed. Plan: 1) lower global RPM for redwood-alpha to protect latency SLOs 2) enact customer-specific uplifts for high-SLA tenants as needed 3) enable temporary traffic shaping (burst windows) 4) monitor and iterate.

priya-s: proposed numbers: current RPM=300, TPM=1,800,000. Suggest lowering RPM -> 120 and TPM -> 720,000 for redwood-alpha. Keep redwood-alpha-quantized variants unchanged for now.

mateo-r: +1. I'll implement a soft throttle (rejects with 429) and sticky headers to avoid user confusion.

clara-h: executing command to update per-model quota for redwood-alpha (global). Leaving a canary window: 10m then widen if no bad regressions.

clara-h: ```
ri-admin quota update --model redwood-alpha --rpm 120 --tpm 720000 --scope global --mode soft
```

ops-bot: ACTION: quota.update started by clara-h at 2024-09-21T11:12:07Z. Request id: qupd-9a3f.

priya-s: saw the throttle applied. Confirming: upstream routers now dropping requests above RPM with 429. Queue length dropped to 40 in 2m. P95 down to 2.1s. Good.

ben_custops: pinging AcmeCorp support: do they need an elevated path? They have a paid latency SLA.

clara-h: we'll open an exception for AcmeCorp: raise per-tenant RPM to 400 for model redwood-alpha for 30 minutes while they finish a scheduled end-user event. Will attach audit and notify billing.

clara-h: ```
ri-admin quota update --customer acmecorp --model redwood-alpha --rpm 400 --tpm 1200000 --duration 30m --note "temp SLA uplift - incident response"
```

ops-bot: ACTION: quota.update started by clara-h at 2024-09-21T11:16:33Z. Request id: qupd-9a3f-acme.

mateo-r: also enabling traffic shaping at the edge to prioritize authenticated requests with header X-RW-SLA: "gold". Rule applied as rate limiter + token-bucket.

priya-s: config snippet pushed to envoy-prod: ```
- name: rw-sla-priority
  match: header("x-rw-sla")
  actions:
    - rate_limit: 100rps per-cluster
    - priority: high
```

ben_custops: AcmeCorp confirmed elevated throughput is flowing through fine after uplift. ZephyrApps still hitting errors, suggesting they weren't eligible for uplift. I'll notify them and offer a scheduled migration to quantized variants.

clara-h: monitoring customer-impact dashboard and error-trace links. Noticing a spike in 429s from low-tier keys; that's expected. Share quick note for product/support to set expectations.

mateo-r: we should also check autoscaling settings for the redwood-alpha pool — there may be a slow scale-up due to cloud provider limits. I'll trigger an emergency scale to +2 nodes.

mateo-r: ```
infractl scale --pool redwood-alpha-pool --delta +2 --reason "incident QPS spike"
```

ops-bot: SCALE: infractl request accepted (req: scale-331). Estimated node ready in 4m.

priya-s: once nodes are up, we'll gradually relax the throttle. For now keep the global RPM at 120 until P95 stays <3s for 10m.

clara-h: handoff: I'm going offline in 35m. @mateo-r will be oncall for the next 2 hours. Mateo please watch the canary window and escalate if P95 creeps back >4s.

mateo-r: acknowledged, picking up. I'll watch logs and adjust customer uplifts if needed.

ben_custops: drafting a customer-facing incident note: short summary + actions taken (global throttle, AcmeCorp uplift, nodes added). Will send to support channel and update tickets.

sre-alerts-bot: NOTE: post-mitigation metric snapshot: queue length 18, P95 1.9s, 429 rate 6.2%.

mateo-r: nodes are up. Observability shows throughput stabilizing. Let's plan to step RPM to 180 for 15m then 240 if stable. I'll run the ramp commands.

mateo-r: ```
ri-admin quota update --model redwood-alpha --rpm 180 --tpm 1080000 --scope global --mode soft
```

priya-s: after step to 180, P95 holds at 2.3s and 429 rate drops to 3.1%. Proceed to 240.

mateo-r: ```
ri-admin quota update --model redwood-alpha --rpm 240 --tpm 1440000 --scope global --mode soft
```

ops-bot: ACTIONS complete. All quota updates applied.

clara-h: good work. Summary for follow-up: root cause likely the variant rollout that increased memory pressure and cache miss rate; mitigations: per-model global soft throttle reduced RPM/TMP, per-customer temporary uplifts, emergency +2 nodes, traffic shaping by SLA header. Next steps: postmortem + recommend reverting rollout or patching kernel fallback.

mateo-r: I'll own the infra follow-up (scale behavior) and work with Priya on runtime patch. Clara, can you own the customer comms and billing exceptions?

clara-h: yes, I'll handle comms + billing audit entries.

ben_custops: support tickets updated, AcmeCorp happy, ZephyrApps offered migration options.

sre-alerts-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated) at 2024-09-21T13:00:00Z. Please file postmortem within 72h.

clara-h: filing postmortem doc now and will link the follow-up tasks. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
